title: Zephyr
summary: For applications built with west and Kconfig.
detail: Select a backend and integrate source or prebuilt libraries with your Zephyr application.

title: neuralSPOT-X
summary: For applications built with Ambiq’s development SDK.
detail: Add the nsx source module, configure its features and link the runtime into the SDK’s CMake build.

title: CMSIS-Pack
summary: For projects managed with CMSIS tooling.
detail: Generate, validate and install a local source pack. Pack validation does not establish support for every IDE or board application.

title: Build from source
summary: For control over compiler options and kernel selection.
detail: Build Make archives or CMake source targets when you need to configure features or debug the runtime.

title: Prebuilt archive
summary: For firmware that links a released runtime library.
detail: Choose an archive with matching architecture, toolchain and features, then link it with compatible headers and ABI settings.
